vectors.precondition: Central introspection returns a session whose bundle or product differs from the Finance registry tuple.
vectors.expectedInvariant: No upstream source is queried and no account data is returned.

vectors.request: GET /api/portfolio with a valid Finance session
vectors.expectedInvariant: Unavailable Explorer evidence never becomes a fake zero-balance claim or synthetic activity.

vectors.precondition: Explorer /health reports ok=true but a native symbol other than YNXT.
vectors.request: Build Portfolio for the authorized account

expectedSourceState.explorerStatus.error: Explorer health failed network or native-asset validation

vectors.expectedInvariant: Finance does not accept balances or activity from a source with mismatched asset identity.

vectors.precondition: Explorer account response address differs from the normalized Wallet-authorized account.
vectors.request: Build Portfolio for the authorized account

expectedSourceState.explorerStatus.error: Explorer returned evidence for a different account

vectors.expectedInvariant: Caller input or upstream substitution cannot switch portfolio identity.

vectors.precondition: A valid activity cursor has one encoded character changed.
vectors.expectedInvariant: No page is returned from a cursor without a valid HMAC-SHA-256 signature.

vectors.precondition: A valid cursor issued to Wallet account A is presented with a valid session for account B.
vectors.expectedInvariant: Cursor payload and current Wallet account must match exactly.

vectors.precondition: The activity IDs or timestamps change after a cursor is issued.
vectors.expectedInvariant: Pagination restarts rather than mixing records from different source snapshots.

vectors.precondition: Pay URL is not configured or the server-side read key is unavailable.
vectors.request: GET /api/portfolio with a valid Finance session
vectors.expectedInvariant: Finance never inserts a placeholder receipt or claims settlement.

vectors.precondition: Pay returns a valid event whose payer, merchant, buyer, seller, signer, from, to and account fields do not match the Wallet account.
vectors.request: Build Portfolio for the authorized account
vectors.expectedInvariant: The event is omitted from payReceipts.

vectors.precondition: AI draft request lacks explicit consent or requests records not owned by the Wallet account.
vectors.expectedInvariant: No private source context is sent and no financial action occurs.

vectors.precondition: No exact owner payload contract has been frozen and explicitly accepted by Finance.
vectors.request: GET /api/sources or GET /api/portfolio with a valid Finance session
vectors.expectedInvariant: No balance, position, PnL, APY, supply or fee payload is inferred while the owner contract is pending.

vectors.precondition: An otherwise valid envelope changes the authorized account, network, native asset, owner, owner contract version or payload schema.
vectors.request: Validate the owner payload through finance-source-read-envelope-v1
vectors.expectedInvariant: Finance never exposes evidence whose account, chain, asset, owner or version binding differs from the accepted contract.

vectors.precondition: A capability such as exchange.withdraw.execute.read or quant.mandate.write.read ends with read but contains mutation semantics.
vectors.request: Validate the accepted contract or source envelope
vectors.expectedInvariant: A .read suffix cannot grant signing, execution, write, control, approval, pause, revoke or settlement authority.

vectors.precondition: The envelope contains an unknown field, future asOf time, incomplete provenance, duplicate capability or empty payload.
vectors.request: Validate the owner payload through finance-source-read-envelope-v1
vectors.expectedInvariant: Malformed or ambiguous provenance cannot become an available Finance source.

vectors.precondition: An operator configures HTTP, javascript or credential-bearing owner navigation URL.
vectors.request: Configure the Finance source action registry
vectors.expectedInvariant: Only reviewed absolute HTTPS navigation is exposed; an action URL never configures a data adapter or marks a source available.

vectors.precondition: An Exchange integration proposes a credential or method with withdrawal execution, owner-change or address-management authority.
vectors.expectedInvariant: Finance accepts withdrawal records as read evidence only and never receives execution credentials.

vectors.precondition: A Quant integration attempts deployment, trade placement, leverage/risk-limit change or mandate mutation from Finance.
vectors.expectedInvariant: Finance renders read-only evidence and navigation to the owner product; it never becomes a Quant Engine or signer.
